title: AmerTac Recalls Night Lights Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: An electrical short circuit in the night light can cause it to overheat and smolder or melt which can burn consumers or result in a fire. Units: About 272,000.

title: The First Years® Recalls American Red Cross® Cabinet Swing Locks; Latches Can Fail to Prevent Access by Children
summary: The installed latches can break and children could gain access to contents of a cabinet, posing the risk of exposure to hazardous items. Units: About 41,300.

title: Lowe's Stores Recall to Repair Roman Shades and Roll-Up Blinds; Two Near Strangulations Involved Young Children
summary: Roman Shades: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. title: Fagor America Inc. Recalls Refrigerators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The refrigerator's control board can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Girls' Hooded Zip Jacket and Vest Sets with Drawstrings Recalled By Splendid Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded zip jackets and the vest sets have drawstrings through the hoods which can pose a strangulation or entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 900.

title: Paging Loudspeakers Recalled By TOA Electronics Due to Risk of Impact Injury
summary: The speaker housing can crack at the mounting bracket, causing the speakers to fall from their mounting. This poses a risk of injury from impact to consumers. Higher failure rates have occurred in high temperature and humidity environments. Units: About 2,600.

title: Sterno Recalls Portable Butane Stoves Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The stove's "on-off" valve can fail to close completely when turned to the "off" position, causing butane to leak from the stove. This poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 37,500.

title: Trimmers/Brushcutters Recalled by STIHL Incorporated Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Vibration from the ignition module may cause the trimmer head to loosen and detach from the mounting, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Electric Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The heaters can malfunction resulting in overheating, smoking, burning, melting and fire. Units: About 2.2 million.

title: Lamps Recalled by CDX Group Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: Substandard electrical wiring, connections and plugs in these lamps pose a fire and shock risk to consumers. Units: About 1,600.

title: Extech Instruments Recalls Digital Clamp and Multimeters due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: When the battery runs low, the meters can fail to give an accurate voltage reading, resulting in the operator falsely believing the electrical power is off or low. This poses an electrocution hazard. Units: 5,100 units.

title: Portable Table-Saws Recalled by Ryobi Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The saw blade on the motor carriage could be misaligned, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 21,500.

title: Cast Iron Skillets Sold by QVC Recalled Due to Burn Hazard; Manufactured by Meyer Trading
summary: Small pieces of the enamel coating can pop off when the skillet is heated, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,500.

title: Seattle Bike Supply Recalls Redline Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The head tube can separate from the frame, causing the rider to lose control and fall. This poses a risk of serious injury. Units: About 200.

title: Toddler Girl Garments Recalled by American Eagle Outfitters Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal clasp at the waistband can detach from the garment, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,200.

title: Circo Children's Camping Combo Pack Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target Stores
summary: The floor of the tent failed a flammability test and poses a fire hazard. Units: 1500.

title: Rachael Ray™ Brand Two Quart Teakettle Recalled by Meyer Corporation, U.S. Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Water heated in the teakettles can spill and spray while being poured, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 59,000.

title: Silver Metallic Pillar Candles Sold Exclusively at Bed Bath & Beyond Stores Recalled By General Wax & Candle Company Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The metallic paint on the candles can ignite, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 12,000.

title: American Honda Recalls Snowblowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank joint and O-ring located on the underside of the fuel tank can seep or drip fuel over time, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 18,500.

title: BabyLegs Recalls Baby Socks and Leg Warmers with Heart Appliqué Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The leg warmers and socks have a heart appliqué that can detach, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 4,500.

title: QVC Recalls Spinning Candle Holders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candle holders can catch fire, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: STIHL Inc. Recalls Chain Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The throttle trigger may stick after it has been released by the operator, which could cause the engine to continue to run at a speed that drives the saw chain. This can pose a risk of a laceration injury to the user or a bystander. Units: About 5,000.

title: BB Buggies Recalls Classic Bad Boy Buggies Again Due To Crash Hazard
summary: The off-road vehicles can accelerate without warning, posing a risk of injury to the user and/or bystanders. Units: About 9,300. (This recall was first announced in October 2009).

title: Ceramic Banks Recalled by Oriental Trading Company Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The yellow surface paint on the banks contains excessive levels of lead which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 220,000.

title: Michaels Stores Recalls Silver Tree Tealight Candle Holders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The tealight cups are positioned where the flame from the candles can ignite other parts of the candle holder, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 7,600 in the United States and 650 in Canada.

title: Zoom Buggy Cars and Dream Pillow Stars Recalled by Kindermusik Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wheels on the Zoom Buggy cars and plastic beads on the Dream Pillow Star can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,000 Zoom Buggy Cars and 300 Dream Pillow Stars were sold in the United States, 1300 Zoom Buggy Cars and 100 Dream Pillow Stars were sold in Canada.
